entities.summary: Yuri Nikolayevich Galtsev is a Russian entertainer and clownery, TV presenter, parodist, singer, theater, film and television actor and Honored Artist of the Russian Federation (2003). Art Director of the Raikin Variety Theater in Saint Petersburg.
